subject: world_language
concept: Unit review and mastery check for the Secondary Transition sequence, confirming CEFR B1 solidification and readiness for full Inquiry Band language study
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any single external curriculum

exercise.pictorial: Mixed set of hypothetical-mood and reading-comprehension questions spanning nodes 01-07
exercise.abstract: Mixed academic vocabulary, writing, idiom, and extended discussion questions spanning nodes 01-07

assessment.mastery_threshold: 8/10 correct across mixed question types, plus a passing extended discussion and written sample
misconception_flags: any single-node misconception flag from 01-07 recurring at this stage

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
next_node_on_fail: WORLDLANG.SECONDARY.TRANSITION.REVIEW (targeted remediation, routes to specific failed sub-node)
